newsitem.title: ITALY: Problems to solve before Enel sale-Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Problems to solve before Enel sale-Ciampi.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said there were still several problems to solve before state electricity group Enel can be privatised.

Ciampi, speaking to the lower house transport committee, said: "There are still a lot of aspects to clarify. We need to see how to let in private operators, if it's possible to think of a plurality of producers and distributors."
"All these are things which remain to be decided," Ciampi said, adding he thought the privatisation of Enel was not a problem which was ready to be addressed yet.
